description: Execution-level races and restart recovery, not planner-only cases. input.scenario selects a reference-executor setup: folder-delete-concurrent-upload inserts an unseen F/new.md after listing; folder-delete-unsupported has no atomic empty-only primitive; new-file-create-race and new-folder-create-race occupy a planned creation path after listing. conflict-copy-restart runs one overlapping edit with losing edit time 1000, injects a crash at input.crashAfter, restarts with durable metadata and completes sync. Existing entries and failed-action records must remain intact. App runners map this file to the shared library's executor contract tests and keep their own adapter/persistence tests.

cases.name: a concurrent child upload survives a planned folder deletion
an unsupported empty-only folder removal fails without a recursive request
a failed conditional child deletion prevents destructive folder removal
a new file upload cannot replace a path created after listing
a planned folder creation cannot adopt an entry created after listing
restart after durable intent creation writes only one losing copy
restart after writing the losing copy reuses it rather than numbering a duplicate
restart after replacing the winner finishes the original copy
restart after recording the winner finishes the original copy
restart after uploading the copy recognizes the completed create-only write
restart after recording the copy clears intent without a duplicate upload
